turns.query: What counts as an API call and how should I configure rate limiting?

segments.text:
API calls are like little door swings at a very busy store: one customer entering is harmless, but autocomplete, filters, page loads, bots, and eager widgets can turn that door into a blur.

If you want predictable cost, treat every search request as something worth shaping rather than something to discover on the invoice.

- Debounce ordinary typing.
- Avoid duplicate page-load searches.
- Put server-side throttling in front of shared backend traffic.

Supporting evidence: [Rate limiting API keys](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/security/api-keys/in-depth/rate-limits/) | [Understand search request usage](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/getting-started/how-algolia-works/in-depth/search-requests/)
